headings.rules: Use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for large sizes. Break standard bold conventions.

body.rules: Keep readable and clean, text-sm to text-base, with high contrast.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 for neutral, 1px solid neon color for active/hover states.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md to rounded-lg max) for a tech/electric feel.

components.name: Header
components.instructions: Sticky header (z-50) using crystal glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Include 'DM Mobile' branding in Unbounded font, bold. Include a cart icon. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds.

components.name: DealRow
components.instructions: A stacked section representing one deal category. Layout: flex-col on mobile, lg:flex-row on desktop. Gap of gap-4 to gap-6.

components.name: PromoPanel
components.instructions: Left-side panel for the deal row (w-full lg:w-1/4 or 1/3). Dark background with a specific neon gradient glow or border. Prominent text for the deal name (e.g., 'Top Selling Deal'). Includes a 'View All' link with an arrow icon. Deep padding (p-6 to p-8).

components.name: ProductStrip
components.instructions: Right-side container. Must be a horizontally scrollable strip on mobile and desktop: flex overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory gap-4 pb-4. Hide the scrollbar (no-scrollbar).

components.name: ProductCard
components.instructions: Individual product card. Min-width around 240px to 280px to fit 5 cards nicely. Dark surface (bg-[#0a0a0a]), border-white/10. On hover: border lights up with the section's neon color, and card lifts up slightly. Includes Product Image (max-h-40 object-contain), Title, Price, and a 'Grab Deal' CTA button. 'Grab Deal' button must have a subtle neon outline or solid neon color on hover.

grids_and_layouts.main_container: max-w-screen-2xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-12
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Rows stack vertically on mobile. Product strips swipe horizontally (snap-x). Use subgrid or flex-shrink-0 for cards to maintain width.

motion.interactions: Use Framer Motion for hover lifts (hover:-translate-y-1) and glowing shadow transitions on product cards. Use subtle entry animations for the rows staggering in.
motion.buttons: Active/press states should scale down slightly (scale-95). Glow intensifies on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glowing neon panels is dark (e.g., text-black) if the background is brightly colored, or keep text white if the background is dark with only neon accents.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (cards, buttons, links) MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='grab-deal-button', data-testid='view-all-link'.

media.icons: lucide-react (ChevronRight, ShoppingCart, Tag, Zap, Box, Star)

images.description: Sleek white earbuds on dark background

media.usage_instructions: Distribute these images across the 5 deal sections (Top Selling, Save Money, Bulk Deal, Today Deal, New Stock Deal) to simulate live product data.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST build the layout described in the problem statement: multi-section deal layout, stacked vertically. Each row has a left promo panel and a horizontal 5-card product strip.
Use the ARCHETYPE 7 (Electric & Neon) color palette to style borders and buttons. Make each section stand out with its unique neon color accent on hover or in the left promo panel.

Implement horizontal scrolling using Tailwind's 'overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory flex gap-4' on the product strips. Do NOT wrap the product strip to the next line; it must stay on one single horizontal row per section.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Open Sans', or 'Lato'. Use 'Unbounded' for headings, and 'Manrope' for body text. Make sure to import them from Google Fonts in the CSS or index.html.
Buttons for 'Grab Deal' should have high-impact neon styles when hovered.
All elements MUST have a data-testid for testing (e.g., data-testid='product-card', data-testid='grab-deal-button', data-testid='view-all').
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on the header or layered cards; use bg-black/60 and backdrop-blur-xl or solid bg-[#0a0a0a].
Mock product data mapping to the provided images to fill out 5 sections x 5 cards.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use deep layered elements with z-index and glassmorphism.
Avoid applying universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease) to prevent breaking transforms.
Do not center-align the main App container globally.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toast notifications if any interactions require them (e.g., Add to cart).
